changelog:
# 📺 Channel Updates 📺
```- Added a full crash handler, with instructions on next steps when a crash happens.
- Added estimated time remaining to update downloads.
- The channel now automatically goes to settings on first launch, or when returning from the pack via "Retro Rewind Channel" button on the main menu.
- Various UX improvements, such as a longer delay before auto launch.
- "main.dol" is now properly patched if present in "MyStuff".
- Performance improvements to file replacements.
- Full support for the new "Patches" system.
- Updater no longer incorrectly reports that large SD cards do not have enough space to install updates.
- General stability improvements.```


# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️ 
```- The crash screen will now provide more information about where exactly the crash occurred and why.
- Optimized the "Patches" system to be less CPU and Memory intensive.
- The “Patches” system now supports BRSAR file formats.
- “Alternative Costumes” can now be chosen on the character select screen by pressing your controller’s L & R buttons.
- Optimized the no lightning flash code to have a more strict value.
- No lightning flash is now enforced in local multiplayer.
- The time trial trophy saving system has been fixed and remade.
- "wifi_bg.brstm" is now separated into 2 BRSTMs! One of these BRSTMs is used only for the "Globe" screen and is called "wifi_globe_bg.brstm" while the other BRSTM called "wifi_lobby_bg.brstm" is used for when you are in a match voting for a track.```

 
# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue that caused the "Patches" toggle to not function properly if a subfile and its main file were both being replaced.
- Fixed an issue that caused LapKO to crash.
- Fixed an issue that caused Pokeys to not respawn if they were hit by a POW during their death.
- Attempted to fix an issue that caused specific players to not appear in the match for other players.
- Fixed an issue where custom items could lead to a crash because of the spinning triple items.
- Fixed an issue that caused Pulsar exclusive BRSTMs to not play properly.
- Fixed an issue that caused the variant indicator to not appear on non-english languages. 
- Fixed an issue that caused author credits to not appear on non-english languages.
- Fixed an issue that caused the B button to activate your current item and start a drift when in hybrid transmission.
- Fixed an issue that caused the online ranking system to appear offline when using a Wii Wheel.
- Fixed an issue that caused the online ranking progression screen to display your VR as 1,000 if your current VR was above 100,000vr.
- Fixed an issue that caused licenses to start with 1vr under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when completing a GP in offline.
- Fixed an issue that caused `Im67` to incorrectly appear as 'ImZeraora'```


On a side note, I would like to thank some community members for their contributions. Thank you ISwearChris for the brand new tracks you have made! They all came out stunning and us at the Retro Rewind Team are very excited to see more of your work! Thank you to mkwcat for their original Mii Outfit C code! Thank you to Mining for helping with specific costumes and making a very neat chart with all of the costumes! Thank you to TheBeefBai for making a few of the custom character voices! Also, updating through the channel will display the version has v7.0.0, but after reloading it will correctly display as 6.10.0! Alongside this, settings have been reset and will need to be reconfigured!
